papers.title: Vision-Language Foundation Models as Effective Robot Imitators

papers.title: Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation
papers.why_it_matters: GR-1 pre-trains a GPT-style model on video prediction and fine-tunes it to predict actions jointly with future frames, showing video pre-training transfers to manipulation.

papers.title: 3D-VLA: A 3D Vision-Language-Action Generative World Model
papers.why_it_matters: Grounds a VLA in 3D scene tokens and couples it with generative goal imagination (images, point clouds), connecting VLAs to 3D world modeling.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.track_or_status: Poster [outside target venue list; included as foundational]

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model

notes: SCOPE: 240 papers (multi-label topics). Topic counts (any tag / first-listed tag): world_models: 46 tagged / 27 primary; vla: 41 tagged / 23 primary; gaussian_splatting_robotics: 36 tagged / 21 primary; humanoids: 27 tagged / 21 primary; digital_twins: 40 tagged / 23 primary; ai_safety: 50 tagged / 44 primary; vision_3d: 47 tagged / 35 primary; vision_4d: 33 tagged / 23 primary; pose_6d: 24 tagged / 23 primary. Venue counts: CVPR: 60; ICLR: 58; NeurIPS: 36; ICML: 25; ECCV: 18; ICCV: 18; Science Robotics: 6; Nature: 4; RSS: 4; arXiv: 4; CoRL: 3; TPAMI: 3; SIGGRAPH: 1. Awards recorded: 38 papers. Confidence: high=214, medium=25, low=1. METHOD: Acceptance and presentation status come from Paper Copilot paperlists JSON (github.com/papercopilot/paperlists; files downloaded to scratchpad/data/paperlists*): CVPR 2019/2021-2025, ICCV 2019/2021/2023/2025, ECCV 2020/2022/2024, NeurIPS 2017/2018/2021-2026, ICML 2017/2019/2021-2026, ICLR 2014/2018/2020-2026, plus CoRL 2022-2025, RSS 2023-2025 and SIGGRAPH 2023 for the few flagged out-of-list foundational items. Candidates were found by keyword/regex search over titles (and abstracts), then hand-selected favouring Oral/Spotlight/Highlight/award status, citation counts and known impact. AWARDS: checked against official pages via web search where possible (CVPR 2025 and 2026 best-paper pages, ICLR blog posts, ICML virtual-site award tags, NeurIPS award PDF/blog, TC-PAMI award pages, ECCV 2026 awards page) and cross-checked with the GitHub list FeijiangHan/Top-Conference-Best-Papers (read from raw.githubusercontent.com). Where only that secondary list supports an award (e.g., ICML 2022 differentiable simulators, ICML 2024 model-stealing, ICML 2025 position paper, ICLR 2024 test-of-time runner-up, ECCV 2024 Rasterized Edge Gradients), confidence is 'medium'. ICCV 2025 RayZer is a Best Paper Honorable Mention per TC-PAMI but a Best Student Paper Honorable Mention per the GitHub list. LIMITATIONS: The shared web-search budget ran out partway through, so Nature, Science Robotics and TPAMI citations (volume and article numbers) were not re-checked online; they are marked medium, and Metric3D v2 (TPAMI) is marked low. Paperlists does not flag orals for CVPR 2023-2025 (only Highlight/Poster, plus 'Award Candidate' for 2025), ICCV 2025, ECCV 2020/2022, or ICML 2026 (only Poster/Spotlight); such entries say 'Accepted (paperlists label: Poster; oral/highlight flag not captured)'. CVPR 2026 and ECCV 2026 are not in paperlists, so those entries rely on official award pages and arXiv author lists (ECCV 2026 author lists come from search summaries; medium). NeurIPS 2026 papers are accepted (paperlists nips2026.json) but the conference has not yet been held (Dec 2026). CODE: every listed GitHub URL (160) was checked to exist by fetching its README from raw.githubusercontent.com; the repo identities are official repos I recalled, and most were also confirmed by matching a paper keyword in the README. Empty code means no repo was confirmed; 1 non-GitHub code link(s) (e.g., Hugging Face model card) were taken from the paper's release page. FLAGGED NON-TARGET ITEMS: 8 peer-reviewed foundational papers from RSS/CoRL/SIGGRAPH-TOG (Diffusion Policy, RT-2, Octo, OpenVLA, pi0, ASAP, MegaPose, 3D Gaussian Splatting) are marked '[outside target venue list; included as foundational]'. 4 arXiv-only safety classics are marked 'arXiv-only'. Pre-2022 foundational papers at target venues are marked '[foundational, pre-2022]'. pi_or_senior_authors is a judgement call (usually last or corresponding authors) and is empty for the ICML 2026 position paper, whose senior author is unknown. CONSIDERED BUT EXCLUDED: these 2024-2026 award papers were judged off-topic or unverifiable: NeurIPS 2025 best paper '1000 Layer Networks for Self-Supervised RL' (goal-conditioned RL; tangential to humanoids and world models); NeurIPS 2025 and 2024 main-track best papers; ICLR 2026 outstanding papers (LLM succinctness, multi-turn conversation); ICLR 2025 HM SAM 2; ICML 2026 outstanding papers (diffusion LMs, sampling theory); ICML 2026 HM 'Confusion map: Deceiving probes to map the emergence of honesty in RLVR' (safety-relevant, but reported only by a secondary source and absent from icml2026.json); CVPR 2023 best paper UniAD (driving); ICCV 2023 Marr Prize ControlNet; NeurIPS 2022 MineDojo. GAPS: no Nature Machine Intelligence or Nature Communications papers, because no candidate could be verified without web search. TPAMI coverage is thin (3). Most humanoid sim-to-real work appears at RSS/CoRL/ICRA/Science Robotics, so humanoid coverage at ML and CV venues is thinner. CVPR 2026 and ECCV 2026 orals are not listed, only their award winners. Test-of-time awards for ICLR 2026, ICCV 2025 and CVPR 2026 were not checked.
